title: Framed Serial Dimmer
summary: Parse complete commands, reject malformed values and recover after an oversized line.

briefing.text: Parse complete commands, reject malformed values and recover after an oversized line.
The parts are placed but unwired. Complete the wiring and sketch, then follow the experiments in Learn to earn each objective.

learn.title: Framed Serial Dimmer
learn.body:
Wire GPIO18 → 220 Ω → LED anode, cathode to GND. Use 8-bit analogWrite values from 0 to 255.

Accept only newline-terminated SET commands followed by one space and one to three decimal digits in range 0–255. For example, SET 64 must apply duty 64 and print OK=64. Do not apply a partial line. Reject extra characters, negative or oversized values, and lines longer than 12 characters with ERR; keep the previous brightness. Ignore carriage returns so the Serial Monitor can send either line ending. After overflow, discard through the next newline and accept the following command normally.

Run and send SET 64, SET 999, SET 12x, a line of 20 x characters, then SET 192. End each line with Send. Expect OK=64, three ERR lines, then OK=192. The LED must keep duty 64 during all errors. Read available characters without a blocking readStringUntil() call.

objectives.text: Connect the placed parts using the pin map in Learn

hints.tier1: Use Learn for the exact power, ground and signal pins. Insert cables into free holes on the same breadboard strip as each leg. The third hint shows the complete wiring.
